services.description: Home shifting for houses and flats of every size. The crew packs each room in turn, labels every box, loads with care and sets your furniture back in place at the new home.
services.goodToKnow: Tell us about stairs, lifts and narrow streets when you ask for a quote, so the right crew and truck are booked for your move.
includes: Room by room packing with labelled boxes
Furniture wrapped and carried with care
Loading, transport and unloading in one booking
Beds and wardrobes set back up at the new home
services.name: Home Shifting
services.short: Houses, flats and family moves, room by room.

services.description: Office shifting planned around your working hours. Desks, computers and files are packed in order, moved together and set out again so the team can get back to work.
services.goodToKnow: Evening and weekend moves can be requested in your quote, so the office move does not stop a working day.
includes: A written moving plan agreed before the day
Desks, chairs and cabinets wrapped and labelled
Computers and files packed in order, office by office
Furniture set out again at the new office
services.name: Office Shifting
services.short: Desks, computers and files moved with a plan.

services.description: Packing and unpacking as a service on its own or as part of a move. Strong boxes, wrap for fragile pieces, clear labels on everything, and unpacking at the other end.
services.goodToKnow: Keep documents, jewellery and medicines with you on moving day. Everything else, we pack.
includes: Strong boxes, wrap and tape supplied
Fragile items wrapped piece by piece
Every box labelled with its room and contents
Unpacking and box removal at the new place
services.name: Packing and Unpacking
services.short: Boxes, wrap and tape, done properly.

services.description: Loading and transport when you have packed yourself or need goods moved on their own. The crew loads, secures everything for the road and unloads at the other end.
services.goodToKnow: Send a short list of the biggest items with your quote request, so the truck size and crew size are right the first time.
includes: Trained crew for heavy and awkward items
Loads secured with straps and blankets for the road
Truck sized to your load, booked in advance
Unloading and placement at the destination
services.name: Loading and Transport
services.short: Heavy lifting and the road in between, handled.

steps.description: It starts with the quote form. Send your name, phone, moving from, moving to, moving date and the service you need, and we come back with a clear quote for the move.
happens: You send the Get a Free Quote form
We read the route, the date and the service
We come back with a clear quote and the next step
You confirm the booking when you are ready
steps.name: Book a Quote
steps.short: Tell us where you are moving from and to.

steps.description: On moving day the crew packs each room in turn, wraps fragile pieces, labels every box and loads the truck in an order that keeps everything safe on the road.
happens: The crew arrives with boxes, wrap and tape
Fragile items are wrapped piece by piece
Boxes are labelled by room and contents
The truck is loaded and the load is secured
steps.name: We Pack and Load
steps.short: Every room packed, labelled and loaded with care.

steps.description: Your goods travel on the booked route in a truck sized for the load, with everything strapped and blanketed so nothing shifts on the way.
happens: The load is checked before the truck leaves
Straps and blankets keep everything in place
The truck follows the route from your quote
We let you know when the truck is on its way
steps.name: Safe Transport
steps.short: Your things travel secured, on the booked route.

steps.description: At the new place the crew unloads, puts furniture where you want it and unpacks the boxes, so the first evening in the new home or office already feels settled.
happens: The truck is unloaded room by room
Furniture is placed where you ask for it
Boxes are unpacked and the packing is taken away
A final walk through with you before we leave
steps.name: Unpack and Settle In
steps.short: Boxes opened, furniture placed, you settle in.
